metadata.catalog_title: Pacts & Polyhedrals Fantasy Minigames and Activities
metadata.note: Full 131-entry design registry: 73 coded-alpha implementations and 58 proposals. Stage 5 adds 14 interactive arena, wizard, bard, grappling, defence and stealth engines plus shared NPC tactics and motion. Coded does not imply live Foundry/Forge certification; implementation_status and release_stage are authoritative.

provenance_labels.existing_browser_prototype: Playable standalone browser prototype; Foundry multiplayer not yet built
provenance_labels.historical_table_rules: Prior TTRPG rules/actual-play use; not Foundry coded
provenance_labels.historical_concept: Prior conversation activity or puzzle; automation proposed
provenance_labels.historical_macro: Earlier Foundry macro, complete live compatibility not verified
provenance_labels.new_proposal: New design proposed for this module

core_rules.host: GM-authoritative validated actions and deterministic replay
core_rules.no_system_lockin: Independent points, dice and turns; optional adapters for D&D5e and other systems
core_rules.gm_npc: GM gets same seat controls as players and may delegate to AI midmatch
core_rules.accessibility: Reduced motion, no-timer mode, captions, color-blind patterns, text labels
core_rules.fairness: No private information in shared packets, auditable game log, configurable stakes or points-only
core_rules.tutorial: Guided demo->practice round->live match with NPC voice/cues and skip option
